questions.text: 1. Why is the family unit important?

2. What is a community and what is its role? The Big Questions Family Almost all of us live in a family. The family is the fundamental and most ancient unit of any society. In Indian society today, there are several types of families — from joint families to nuclear families. A joint family has several generations living together — grandparents, parents, uncles and aunts, Love and dharma are the flower and fruit of family life. — Tiruvalluvar Examples of joint families
